name: Bodyweight Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with your weight shifted onto one grounded foot and a slight soft bend in your standing knee.
Brace your core and hinge forward at your hips as your free leg extends straight behind you.
Reach both hands smoothly toward the floor with a flat spine until your torso approaches parallel and your standing hamstring stretches.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your standing glute to return upright, then switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep both hip bones pointing straight toward the floor instead of twisting your lifted hip open.
Move smoothly as one straight line from your head to your back heel without rounding your spine.
